visual_review.observations: No clipping, overlap, black boxes, missing glyphs, unreadable formulas, or broken running heads were observed. Dense sequent-calculus and natural-deduction proof trees remain legible and inside the page area. Devanagari shaping, headings, page numbers, source-correction notes, links, and bibliography entries render cleanly. The mostly blank chapter-boundary page 73 and sparse final bibliography page 133 are intentional layout outcomes. Empty squares at proof endings are the intended QED marks.
